changes.source:
疲労回復力はペナントモードで選手を試合に出し
た際に溜まる疲労を回復するスピードです。
これが高い選手は一年間使い続けても安定した能
力を発揮することができます。
changes.previous_english:
Recovery determines how quickly players
recover from fatigue in Pennant mode.
A high rating helps a player perform
consistently throughout a full season.
changes.english:
Fatigue Recovery determines how fast
fatigue clears in Pennant mode.
A high rating helps a player perform
consistently throughout a full season.

changes.source:
【先発・リリーフの向き不向き】
先発調整力・疲労回復力の違いで、その選手が先発向きかリリーフ向きかを考えよう。

先発調整力の高い投手は、先発調整をしたとき、先発スタミナが最大にたまるまでの日数が早いぞ。
つまり短い間隔で先発登板できる。

疲労回復力の高い投手は、疲労の回復が早くて疲れがたまりにくい。
リリーフで過酷な連投をさせても耐えることができるぞ。

投手たちをうまく使いこなし、君の手でチームを優勝に導こう！

<+LR>切替<○>閉じる 5/5
changes.previous_english:
[Starting-Relief suitability]
Starter Recovery and Fatigue Recovery help determine whether a pitcher suits starting or relief.

Pitchers with high Starter Recovery regain full starting stamina sooner when using Starter Preparation.
They can recover on shorter rest and start more often.

High Fatigue Recovery means fatigue clears quickly.
Relievers can handle consecutive appearances more easily.

Manage your staff wisely and lead the team to a championship!

<+LR>Pages<○>Close 5/5
changes.english:
[Starting-Relief suitability]
Starter Conditioning and Fatigue Recovery determine suitability for starting or relief.

High Starter Conditioning restores Starter Stamina sooner with Starter Preparation.
They can recover on shorter rest and start more often.

High Fatigue Recovery means fatigue clears quickly.
Relievers can handle consecutive appearances more easily.

Manage your staff wisely and lead the team to a championship!

<+LR>Pages<○>Close 5/5

changes.source:
【投手コンバート】
投手の調整力を、先発タイプかリリーフタイプに少しだけシフトさせることができるぞ。

先発タイプは先発調整力が高く、リリーフタイプは疲労回復力が高い。

上手く投手陣がローテーションを回せるように調節していこう。<+LR>切替<○>閉じる 5/5
changes.previous_english:
[Pitcher Role Conversion]
Move preparation toward a starter or reliever role in
small steps.

Starter types have higher Starter Prep, while reliever
types have higher Recovery.

Balance your staff to keep the rotation running
smoothly.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 5/5
changes.english:
[Pitcher Role Conversion]
Shift conditioning toward a starter or reliever role in
small steps.

Starters have higher Starter Conditioning.
Relievers have higher Fatigue Recovery.

Balance your staff to keep the rotation running
smoothly.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 5/5

context_decisions: Starter Conditioning names the stamina-preparation attribute; Starter Cond. is its compact label.
Starter Prep and Prepare as Starter remain commands; do not globally replace them with the attribute name.
Fatigue Recovery is the full stat name; Recovery remains a compact label, also supported by the 2026 localization.
The role-conversion tooltip now distinguishes higher Starter Conditioning from higher Fatigue Recovery.
C-or-higher tooltips preserve the Spirits threshold while keeping the full stat names.
layout_estimate_scope: Arial 16 px comparative estimates only; the compact bonus label increases from 107 to 116 px. Live widget width remains unverified.
pending: Live stat-label, +1 bonus, grade-threshold, role-help and event-reward placement; source nomenclature and runtime bounds are checked separately.
